nativeComparisons.compares: Exact rawvideo bytes and framecrc text from .build/reference/ffmpeg run at test time, against dilateVideoFrame, compileVideoFilterChain, the FFmpeg frontend with createMediaBackend (-vf and -filter_complex), createReplayVideoExecution, and createTimedVideoBackend with pull/activation/producer schedulers (432 runs = 144 native runs x 3 schedulers). Plus 171 kernel and 25 path refusals of width-1 planes.

unsupported: High-bit-depth native formats (9..16-bit YUV/GBR(A)P/gray) and yuva422p, yuva444p, yuv440p, yuv411p, yuv410p, gbrap, yuvj*: absent from the shared negotiation table

Packed RGB sources with alpha (rgba/bgra/argb/abgr): native negotiates gbrap, which the shared table lacks, so the output diverges from native (not refused; the descriptor cannot see the source format)
Planes narrower than 2 pixels (native reads past the row): refused
Runtime commands (threshold*, coordinates): refused with ENOSYS; enable command gives AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME

notes: Kernel is self-contained in video-ops/dilation.ts and imports only the existing filterIntegerOption (activation/integer-option.ts) for AV_OPT_TYPE_INT parsing; nothing is shared with the erosion/deflate/inflate branches.
All five paths flagged (linear, graph, stream, actor, timed) after the timed-backend tests passed on pull, activation and producer schedulers.

Needed shared edit (not made): adding gbrap to packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/formats.ts negotiationOrder and avutil pixelLayout would make packed RGBA-family sources match native; today they silently negotiate a different format.
Kernel, pixel-format list and border tables are also exported from the module (not from packages/avfilter/src/index.ts, which this branch must not edit); tests import them by path.
Setup durations: submodule 40s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 143s, baseline checks 55s, baseline unit 73s, differential suite ~17s.
